evals.name: python-api-tests
evals.prompt: Use $python to implement an async FastAPI receipt endpoint and its regression tests in backend/. pyproject.toml requires-python is >=3.11,<3.12, the lock pins FastAPI with Pydantic2 and SQLAlchemy2. Keep external mail calls offline in tests.
evals.expected_output: Use thin Router → Service → Repository, Depends session/auth injection, request/response schemas with explicit response_model/status_code, one transaction per use case, parameterized queries and eager loading. RED-first tests use asyncio_mode=auto, in-memory isolated SQLite and httpx AsyncClient+ASGITransport with dependency overrides; test validation/auth/error outcomes and opt-in live markers. Respect configured coverage floor, do not invent a universal threshold.
evals.expected_action_trace: Scoped implementation/tests authorized; no real provider/network, shared DB writes, migration execution, commit or push.

evals.name: python-static
evals.prompt: Use $python to configure ruff and pyright strict for backend/. It targets Python3.10 with requires-python >=3.10,<3.11. Keep existing runtime behavior unchanged and report the exact check commands.
evals.expected_output: Configure ruff target-version/line-length and explicit rule selection, distinct lint versus format-check gates, chosen pyright version and strict mode. Explain scoped specific suppressions with reasons and runner fallback. Do not introduce TaskGroup which requires3.11, or pretend missing tools passed.
evals.expected_action_trace: Only requested tooling config edits/checks; no auto-fix or application behavior edits beyond authorization.

evals.name: python-ambiguity
evals.prompt: Use $python to migrate our services to modern Python async patterns. packages/a requires >=3.9,<3.12 while packages/b requires >=3.11. I have not picked a package or destination version. The shell has Python3.13.
evals.expected_output: Ask for target package and explicit migration destination and wait. Explain broad ranges do not establish a3.11 floor; installed interpreter is environment evidence. No versioned guidance or dependent edits before the answer.
evals.expected_action_trace: Inspect configuration and clarify only. No blanket upgrades, type syntax changes or migrations.
